checks.expected: I’m interested in this role because it applies agentic LLM systems to a concrete optimization problem: diagnosing advertiser-account health, recommending auditable actions, and keeping automated tuning measurable before live spend. My fit is strongest where the role needs rigorous ML experimentation plus practical agent/tool building. At Arborphy AI, I built a multi-agent reasoning prototype with autonomous tool generation, constrained iterative planning, per-step information-gain evaluation, and knowledge-graph evidence aggregation, and I also developed disjoint benchmarks and retrieval/evaluation workflows. My Columbia work strengthened my grounding in deep learning, advanced ML, and careful ablations. I’ve also integrated locally hosted language models into a robotics control workflow and built real-time asynchronous vision pipelines, so I’m comfortable connecting models to systems rather than treating them as notebooks only.
